messages:
julia (AE): Quick heads-up — Orion Corp approved a 10-day POC. They need a hosted API key that is scoped to text generation + embeddings, locked to 3 static IPs, and with an automatic rotation at day 5. Can we provision before tomorrow morning?

noah (SE): Thanks. Can we confirm expected load? embeddings vs generation split? Will they use streaming? Also who to bill?

julia (AE): Light load: ~2 qps generation, 1 qps embeddings. No streaming. Billing contact: procurement@orion.example.com (cc'd in email).

lee (Solutions Eng): OK. Plan: issue a short-lived hosted key with scopes [generate.text, embed.v1], set expires_at to POC end + 1 day, and schedule an automated rotation job at 5 days to issue a replacement and revoke the old. Label format: orion-poc-2026-05-10. Region should be eu-west (they're on Azure Ireland).

maria (Security): Security checklist: 1) IP allowlist required, no CIDR ranges > /24. 2) Audit logs must be retained for 90 days for this POC. 3) Ensure key does not inherit broad org roles. If they plan to send any customer personal data, we escalate.

sam (DevEx): I can do the provisioning. I'll follow this flow: create key via admin API with allowed_ips array, set metadata: {"label":"orion-poc-2026-05-10","purpose":"sales-poc","contact":"procurement@orion.example.com"}, enable audit_log:true, ttl set to 11 days. Then create a rotation ticket that runs at day 5 to create a new key and automatically revoke the old one.

noah (SE): Is there a safe way to hand the secret to the customer? We usually provide a temporary secret via a secure artifact or password manager.

sam (DevEx): We don't post secrets in Slack. Options: 1) Use our portal one-time secret reveal (preferred), 2) Create a short-lived secret and send via the vendor-approved secure link. I'll coordinate with procurement.

lee (Solutions Eng): Also recommend enabling rate limits on the key for POC to protect against accidental token leaks: max 10 qps.

maria (Security): Approved if: IPs provided (no wildcards), audit_log enabled, TTL <= 14 days, and key label references the POC. Also request that the AE confirms no ingestion of regulated data.

julia (AE): Confirmed: no regulated data. Attaching IP list now: 52.210.34.10/32, 13.75.190.22/32, 40.77.167.5/32.

sam (DevEx): Creating key now. Script I use (admin token required):

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/admin/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"label":"orion-poc-2026-05-10","scopes":["generate.text","embed.v1"],"allowed_ips":["52.210.34.10/32","13.75.190.22/32","40.77.167.5/32"],"expires_at":"2026-05-21T23:59:59Z","audit_log":true,"rate_limit_qps":10}'
```

sam (DevEx): Key created. ops-bot will publish provisioning metadata (no secret). I'll trigger portal one-time reveal and create rotation job for day 5.

ops-bot: key_provisioned: {"key_id":"key-0a1b-orion","label":"orion-poc-2026-05-10","expires_at":"2026-05-21T23:59:59Z","allowed_ips":["52.210.34.10/32","13.75.190.22/32","40.77.167.5/32"]} (secret not logged) :white_check_mark:

noah (SE): Nice. I'll send the onboarding note + how-to for the one-time secret retrieval to procurement and loop in solutions documentation.

maria (Security): Please add the audit-log export to the security slack channel for visibility.

sam (DevEx): Will do. Rotation job scheduled: create new key on 2026-05-16T09:00Z, wait 10 minutes for validation, then revoke old key via DELETE /v1/admin/keys/{old_key_id}. If anything fails, the rollback policy keeps the old key for another 24h and alerts oncall.

julia (AE): Thanks team — closing once rotation job completes successfully. :handshake:
